properties.note: Pre-reaction complex HN=NH...H2C=CH2 (0 imaginary frequencies, 24 modes, lowest 41.2 cm-1). This is the lowest-energy verified minimum of the reactant complex (trans-diimide stacked conformer), used as the barrier reference. The cis-diimide six-membered-arrangement conformer that the concerted IRC actually reaches is rc_scan/C1_sideon_cis_optfreq.log (E = -189.094518683, 0 imag), i.e. +2.57 kcal/mol above this reference; from that cis complex the same TS1 barrier is 0.84 kcal/mol.

Concerted six-membered-ring cis H-transfer saddle; one imaginary frequency -446.5 cm-1 with equal displacement of the two transferring H (H3->C5, H4->C6); N-N 1.197, N-H 1.129, C...H 1.688, C=C 1.371 A. Bidirectional GS2 IRC verified (ts/ts_0003).

N2 + C2H6 product state (0 imaginary frequencies); the IRC product direction leads to separated N2 + ethane, each also verified independently (rc_scan/mon_N2_optfreq.log, rc_scan/mon_ethane_optfreq.log).
